visualCharacteristics.purpose: Brand promo banner: background photo with a large overlapping colored text panel (logo, heading, paragraphs, CTA) and a circular badge image
visualCharacteristics.layout: Panel spans the left ~75% and overlaps the top of a background photo anchored to the right; badge image sits at the panel's right edge

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: optional logo picture, heading (h2), paragraphs, CTA link, optional badge picture after the heading. The badge may also be a separate picture-only row

usage.description: Parent-brand or cross-promotion banner near the bottom of a page.

reuseGuidance: Use when a text panel with logo overlaps a photo and carries a badge. For a top-of-page hero with a product cutout use hero-product.
